parsed.rationale: This is a regular sinus rhythm (about 50 bpm) with a narrow QRS and normal PR. The only ST change is slight concave J-point elevation with tall T waves in V2-V3, a benign early-repolarization pattern, so there are no reciprocal changes, Q waves, or ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria.
